Are you technically skilled and do you enjoy working on complex technical assemblies in a modern production environment? For an innovative high-tech company in the Tilburg region, we are looking for a Module Assembly Operator. In this role, you will work on high-quality modules where precision, craftsmanship, and quality are central within a technically advanced production environment where complex three-dimensional modules are assembled, welded, and tested according to strict quality standards.

As a Module Assembly Operator, you will be responsible for assembling and welding complex modules. You will work based on technical drawings and execute work orders according to planning. Your tasks include TIG welding components, including welding with orbital welding heads, and assembling parts into complete modules.

In addition, you will test, measure, and inspect the modules to ensure they meet all required quality and safety standards. You will operate machines, set them up, adjust them when necessary, and perform first-line maintenance to ensure the production process runs smoothly.

Besides the assembly and welding activities, you will carry out repair work and contribute to pilot projects and the development of new products. You will digitally register completed work orders in the system and support colleagues by sharing knowledge and providing instructions when needed.

Within this role, you are also expected to actively contribute ideas for improving processes and working methods. This is a technical and responsible position where technical insight, three-dimensional thinking, independence, and teamwork come together within a modern high-tech production environment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
- Strong spatial and technical 3D insight
- Good command of English
- Experience with metalworking
- Minimum mbo level 3 education in a technical field (preferably mechanical engineering or mechatronics)

jobs.description:
About Grupo Pampling

We are a textile company founded in Seville over 20 years ago, with a presence across Spain, Europe, and Latin America through more than 100 company-owned stores and a strong online channel that connects us with customers worldwide. Our philosophy is based on offering original and sustainable fashion, fostering creativity, diverse talent, and responsible production.

Our portfolio includes brands with their own unique identity: Pampling, Wituka, Pájaro Flama, Nerry, Nostalgic Apparel, Agobio, Catharsis, BM Collective, Citees, Pampling&Co, among others. We also have our own screen-printing workshop, Print Guru (El Pulpo), which allows us to oversee every stage of production and ensure outstanding quality. In addition, we manage our logistics and distribution in-house, optimizing processes and providing an agile response across all our sales channels.

Who are we?

We are a diverse and dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and the drive to take on new challenges. We are looking for people with initiative, commitment, and a passion for design, fashion, and innovation. Our goal is to continue growing alongside a dedicated team while maintaining our focus on delivering high-quality products, competitive prices, and excellent customer service.

What are we looking for?

We are looking to hire Sales Assistants for our new Pampling&Co store located in Amsterdam city centre.

These are part-time positions of 20 and 30 hours with rotating morning and afternoon shifts, with an expected start date of September the 25th.

Previous customer service experience and a good level of English is required.

Main Responsibilities

- Advise and assist customers throughout their shopping experience.

- Answer customer inquiries, resolve issues, and process payments at the checkout.

- Support inventory management, stock control, orders, and warehouse operations.

- Maintain store visual standards in line with the brand's identity and values.
